title: schoenoplectus × carinatus subsp. kuekenthalianus
intro: Schoenoplectus × carinatus subsp. kuekenthalianus, commonly known as hybrid cattail or cattail, is a plant species that belongs to the family Typhaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schoenoplectus × carinatus subsp. kuekenthalianus include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial infections, and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
